profiles.name: Red Pyramid Thing — Return to Silent Hill

limits: Native Canvas 2D rendering, not a browser, DOM, HTTP, service-worker or gameplay session.
Uses current art/registry.json with fresh raster-validation bounds in memory; generated manifests are not rebuilt or mutated.
Calls the real drawRasterMonster, paintRasterPortrait, combatFraming, completeSpriteBox and rasterPlacement dependencies.
Idle snapshots at chosen QA actor coordinates; no simulation or source-animation timing is evaluated.
Opposite directions are runtime mirrors of one native source image, not independently observed anatomy.
Fractional scaling can produce small native rasterization differences between reflected pixel buffers; placement symmetry and pixel differences are reported separately.
Complete delivered pixel bounds and calibration can be checked; missing canonical anatomy, 1:1 fidelity, poses and animations cannot be certified.
Source combat-role restrictions remain unchanged; a reference-only dossier can be rendered without authorizing a match.
